posts.author: Mina
posts.body: Shipped the new focus-visible outlines across the log views. Keyboard users get a consistent ring on every card now. ⌨️

image.alt: Three stacked cards with the middle one wrapped in a thick blue focus ring.

posts.author: Kai
posts.body: Reminder: this feed is demo-only. No customer data, no production APIs — just a place to celebrate the small wins.

posts.author: Ari
posts.body: Release v1.3.0 is out and linked to its decisions in the release log. Nice to have the reasoning travel with the work.

image.alt: A bar chart of five releases, each taller than the last, over a labelled baseline.

posts.author: Priya
posts.body: Arrow keys now walk the feed as a grid: left and right step a card, up and down step a whole row. Home and End still jump to the ends.

image.alt: A nine-tile grid with the centre tile outlined in green and arrow keys pointing out of it.
